ambient_events: The wind reshapes an ash dune and reveals the rusted ribs of a machine.
Ash lifts off the reach in a long grey sheet and settles a field over.
description: An open reach of drifted ash that the wind sculpts into low dunes and then, bored, flattens again. Old machine-bones surface and submerge in it like the tide has teeth.
name: Ash Reach
